raw_text: Prigozhin has declared a march of justice. Wagner columns are moving north from Rostov. Military vehicles spotted on M4 highway heading toward Moscow. This is not a drill — the Grey Zone confirms mobilization orders have been issued to all Wagner units in the Southern Military District.
